spans.s:
लिश् 1. लिश् (according to some a later
form of rt. 1. रिश्), cl. 6. P. लिशति (ac-
cording to some also A. लिशते), to tear off, hurt,
injure, (in this sense only if identified with rt. 1. रिश्);
to go, move; cl. 4. P. लिश्यति (also A. लिश्यते),
लिलेश, लिलिशे, लेक्ष्यति, -ते, अलिक्षत्, अलिक्षत,
लेष्टुम्, to be small, lessen, become small [cf. rts.
कृश्, क्लिश्]: Caus. लेशयति, अलीलिशत्: Desid. लि-
लिक्षते: Intens. लेलिश्यते, लेलेष्टि; [cf. Gr. ὀλί-
γος, perhaps also λίγδος; Lith. lesas.]

2. लिश्, ट्, ट्, ट्, (probably) one who tears off or
injures, &c.

लिश, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) tearing, injuring, &c.;
(see कुलिश.)
लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, lessened, decreased, reduced.

लिष्व लिष्व, अस्, m. = लष्व, a dancer,
actor.
